svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: LLMs and agents: Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Llama 3.3 70B, LangGraph, LangChain, DSPy, Hugging Face, pgvector, Ollama. ML and vision: TensorFlow, OpenCV, pandas, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LightGBM, MLflow, YOLOv5, MediaPipe. Backend and data: Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, SQLite. Cloud and ops: Docker, Azure, AWS, GH Actions, Vercel, Neon, Inngest.
